events.body:
You can line up a couple of weeks of Facebook and Instagram posts in Buffer, then still drop in a timely update when something happens in the shop.

Posting day by day, it's easy to fall behind when the week gets busy — and there's nothing holding the plan together when something suddenly needs to go out.

Here's how it works: Buffer runs from a queue. Set your posting times, then fill the next week or two ahead.

When something timely comes up, create that post and drop it into the next available slot — or drag it to the front. The rest of the queue simply shifts around it.

Foster Coffee, a fellow local business, plans far enough ahead to stay off the weekly scramble and still clicks and drags in last-minute changes.

Before you build a week's queue, it's worth seeing what the Free plan covers: up to 3 connected channels and **10 scheduled posts per channel** at a time, with a slot freeing up each time a post publishes.
events.call_to_action: Learn more about our plans and pricing
events.postscript: The Free plan is free forever, so you can see how a queue fits your week before committing to anything.

events.body:
You post to Facebook and Instagram yourself, when there's a gap in the day to do it.

That holds up until a week gets busy — posting in the moment means a post only goes out when you're free to stop and send it.

Buffer is social media scheduling software for small businesses. You line up a week or two of posts ahead in a queue, then drag them into the order you want.

When something local happens in the shop, you drop a timely post into the next open slot — the rest of the queue stays put.

The Free plan is **free forever, no credit card**. It connects up to 3 channels and holds **10 scheduled posts per channel** at a time; once one publishes, that slot opens up again.

Before you try a weekly queue, it's worth seeing what fits. The plans page shows the channel count and per-channel post limit, so you can tell whether the Free plan covers your posting before you sign up.
events.call_to_action: See what the Free plan includes

events.body:
Line up a week of posts, then something happens in the shop worth posting today — and the plan feels too set to touch.

Buffer is social media scheduling software for planning your own Facebook and Instagram posts. It works from a queue: set your posting times, and it fills your chosen slots in order.

When something timely comes up, create that post and drop it into the next open slot — or drag it to the front. The rest of the queue just shifts around it.

Foster Coffee queues far enough ahead to stay off the weekly scramble for content, and still clicks and drags in last-minute changes when they need to.

On the Free plan you keep up to **10 scheduled posts per channel** at a time; each time one publishes, that slot opens again to refill — enough to run a steady weekly queue across Facebook and Instagram.

Worth checking the official Free plan against how you'd actually want to run yours before you build a week out.
